meta.title: Solitaire — patience with cards, without ads
meta.description: Klondike solitaire with big, easy-to-read cards. By default every deal can be won; hints and undo are free and unlimited. No ads, no accounts, no tracking; works offline.

about.title: About the game
about.rules: Put every card on the four foundations, each suit from the ace to the king. In the columns, lay cards downwards in alternating colours (a red nine on a black ten); you can move several open cards in order together. Only a king goes to an empty column. A face-down card turns up when nothing lies on it. Tap the stock to turn cards; when it is empty, the waste turns over.
about.text: Solitaire without ads, accounts or tracking. Progress stays on this device. Works offline.
about.keys: Keyboard: arrows — move between cards and places, Enter or Space — like a tap, D — the stock, H — hint, Ctrl+Z — undo, F — finish, N — new deal, Esc — close.
